name: Collin Mauren
summary: Collin Mauren is a human mage residing in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind City. A scholarly researcher and crafter of incantations, he experiments with exotic natural reagents to devise unique utility spells. Among his pursuits is assisting his acquaintance, the gnome engineer and explorer Gaxim Rustfizzle, with specialized arcane scrolls.

sections.title: Scholar of the Arcane
sections.body: Situated within Stormwind's bustling Mage Quarter, Collin Mauren spends his days pursuing the quieter, more practical applications of magic. Rather than chasing raw elemental power, he focuses on crafting arcane formulas that solve specific, logistical problems. Collin often turns to natural anomalies and raw components scavenged across Azeroth, weaving their intrinsic properties into functional magic scrolls and reagents for friends and travelers alike.

sections.title: Aiding Gaxim Rustfizzle
sections.body: Collin maintains a close friendship with the gnomish tinker Gaxim Rustfizzle. When Gaxim needed a way to set off his NG-5 explosives from a distance, Collin worked out that a messaging spell would do the job. To impress the spell onto a scroll, he uses debris from Westfall's erratic Dust Devils, and he looks forward to hearing how his inventive friend's scheme turns out.

sections.title: Exotic Studies in Stonetalon
sections.body: Beyond his work with local elementals, Collin's research extends clear across the Great Sea to the crags of Kalimdor. Curiously captivated by the resilient hides of basilisks native to the Stonetalon Mountains, Collin seeks out their scales to synthesize new spells. Travelers venturing into Kalimdor frequently receive his requests for these rare hides, fueling Collin's ongoing fascination with how primal creature anatomy can stabilize complex enchantments.

faq.q: Where can Collin Mauren be found?
faq.answer: Collin Mauren is located in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind City, tucked among the towers and shops frequented by the capital's arcane scholars.

faq.q: What kind of magic does Collin specialize in?
faq.answer: Collin specializes in applied enchantments and utility spells. Rather than combat evocations, he experiments with raw natural components—such as elemental debris and beast scales—to devise scrolls such as the messaging spell he adapted for Gaxim's remote explosives, along with other unique dweomers.

faq.q: Who is Gaxim Rustfizzle and how is Collin connected to him?
faq.answer: Gaxim Rustfizzle is an adventurous gnome tinkerer and a friend of Collin. When Gaxim needed a way to detonate his explosives from afar, Collin crafted him a scroll bearing a messaging spell.

faq.q: Why does Collin need elemental debris from Westfall?
faq.answer: Collin needs debris from one of Westfall's Dust Devils to impress a messaging spell onto a scroll. Gaxim Rustfizzle wants that spell so he can set off his NG-5 explosives from a distance.

faq.q: Why is Collin interested in the Stonetalon Mountains?
faq.answer: Collin studies the magical properties of basilisk scales native to the Stonetalon Mountains in Kalimdor. He uses their sturdy, naturally resistant hides as reagent bases to synthesize new incantations.

faq.q: Is Collin aligned with the Kirin Tor?
faq.answer: While Collin resides in the Mage Quarter and practices the traditions common among Alliance wizards, he functions primarily as an independent researcher and reagent crafter rather than an active Dalaran representative.

angles.text: Collin exemplifies the experimental craft of spell creation, demonstrating how earthly reagents like elemental debris and basilisk scales can be harnessed to weave utility magic.
Living quietly in Stormwind's Mage Quarter, Collin represents the scholarly pursuits of human wizards who study the broader world from the heart of the capital.
Collin facilitates communication and trade across the Alliance by supplying adventurers with utility magic spanning from Westfall to Kalimdor.
